sections.title: 一、主占之辞与卦义
sections.text: 主占之辞 九二：鸣鹤在阴，其子和之，我有好爵，吾与尔靡之。此辞见于本卦火风鼎九二，亦见于之卦风泽中孚九二。鹤鸣于阴而子和，好爵与尔共靡，是同类相感、诚信相与之义。本卦火风鼎卦辞：元吉、亨。鼎以烹饪为象，取新而养人，合作之事有可为之基。之卦风泽中孚卦辞：豚鱼吉，利涉大川，利贞。中孚以信为主，信及豚鱼则吉，利涉大川则险可济，然必以贞正为守。合主占与两卦辞观之，伙伴之合，以诚信相应为本，非仅以势利相结。

sections.title: 二、卦时卦德与处境
sections.text: 月建戌，火风鼎之九二为实腹之位。本卦九二：鼎有实，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。有实而不即于仇，是内有所守而外无所争。然本卦九四：鼎折足，覆公𫗧，其形渥，凶。鼎足既折，则公食倾覆，其形沾湿，是任重而力不副、位高而措置失当之象。之卦中孚六三：得敌，或鼓或罢，或泣或歌。两相匹敌，则进退歌泣皆不能自主。九五：有孚孪如，无咎。信而相牵，则无咎。上九：翰音登于天，贞凶。鸡鸣之声上闻于天，非其分而声过其实，守此则凶。辅占之辞 上九：翰音登于天，贞凶。是戒虚声胜而实德衰。鼎实与中孚并见，是合作有可成之机；然折足、翰音二戒，则不可恃信而忘备，不可张声而失实。

sections.title: 三、处世之道与行动
sections.text: 以义理言，合作之成否，不在别人承诺之厚薄，而在己与彼之实与信。本卦九二既言“鼎有实”，则当先审己之所有、所任、所期，不可空言合而实不至。之卦中孚九二既言“我有好爵，吾与尔靡之”，则当以诚与共，不藏私、不独享。中孚初九：虞吉。有它，不燕。是始交之际当专一，若别有他属，则不安。本卦九三：鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨亏悔，终吉。中途或有举步塞滞、美利不食之时，守待雨至，则悔亏而终吉。故不宜因一时不进即生猜嫌。本卦六五：鼎黄耳，金铉，利贞。居中而贞，则举鼎有其具。是合作当有明约、定分、各守其位，不可徒以情信。若情信虽笃而约不立、分不明，则近于九四折足之患。至若上九翰音之戒，更当省察：凡夸大其规模、先声后实者，不可从。

sections.title: 一、用神旺衰空破
sections.text: 用神官鬼临2爻，世爻即用神，原文标为「死」且落旬空；月建为戌，日辰庚申而旬空子丑，用神在月日无助，空而无力。鼎九二云「鼎有实，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉」，纵有实体，仇敌相阻，暂时难逼近成事。

sections.title: 二、原神忌神
sections.text: 3爻妻财、4爻妻财俱动，皆化子孙回头生，原文标为「原神」，说明利益与资源端可生助；但1爻子孙虽动化兄弟回头生，原文标为「忌神」，5爻子孙临应动化兄弟回头生，亦标为「忌神」，忌神两处发动，反夺原神之力。用神所忌者正是子孙，故合作中易被条件、分配、口头承诺反复牵制。

sections.title: 三、世应与动变
sections.text: 世在2爻官鬼，应为5爻子孙，世应俱动：世动则心念与角色易变，应动化兄弟回头生，对方立场易转。原文「我仇有疾，不我能即」正合当前世应相持；辅占上九「翰音登于天，贞凶」，虚声高张则凶，合作若只凭愿景与声势，反易败事。主占九二「鸣鹤在阴，其子和之，我有好爵，吾与尔靡之」提示先求同声相应、共享其利，方有转机。

sections.title: 四、应期
sections.text: 用神旬空，出空之期方见实质消息：旬空为子丑，故子、丑出空时是首个观察窗口；又官鬼在亥，亥月亦是应期之一。成立条件是：出空或亥月前后必须见到白纸黑字的权责与分配落实，且双方不再以兄弟爻所主的口舌争夺取代实际履约；若只闻其声、不见其行，上九「翰音登于天，贞凶」即应。

sections.title: 一、体用生克
sections.text: 体为离火，用为巽木。木生火，用生体，本属用助体。然本站取法以体用生克参月建戌，戌为土月，火生土而泄气，木亦受土耗。故生中有耗，合作可成而体易劳。主占之辞九二：鸣鹤在阴，其子和之，我有好爵，吾与尔靡之。此象彼此相应、利益可分，提示合伙之始有诚意。辅占之辞上九：翰音登于天，贞凶。高鸣而无实，则凶。故体用虽见生，仍须防虚声。

sections.title: 二、互卦与变卦
sections.text: 互卦泽天夬，变卦风泽中孚。夬者决也，中孚者信也。鼎变中孚，由器入信，事之成败不在鼎之大小，而在孚之有无。本卦九四：鼎折足，覆公𫗧，其形渥，凶。若分工不明、承载失衡，则如鼎折足而覆食。之卦六三：得敌，或鼓或罢，或泣或歌。合伙中易有进退不一之象，宜先定约。

sections.title: 三、时令与行动
sections.text: 月建戌，土旺。体离火生戌土，用巽木又克戌土，木土相战，事多反复。鼎卦辞：元吉、亨。本为通泰，但非指不劳而成。中孚卦辞：豚鱼吉，利涉大川，利贞。诚信及于微物，方可涉险。今岁合作可谈，可试，不可骤信。行动宜先小后大，先明后合。

1. The strength, weakness, voidness, and damage of Yong Shen

The Yong Shen (the key element for the question) is the Officer, sitting on the second line. The Shi Yao (the self line) is itself the Yong Shen. The original text marks it as "dead" and it falls into Xun Kong (void branches). The Yue Jian (month ruler) is Xu, the Ri Chen (day ruler) is Gengshen, and the void branches are Zi and Chou. The Yong Shen receives no support from the month or the day, being void and without strength. The second line of the Ding hexagram says, "The cauldron contains food. My rival is ill and cannot come near me. Good fortune." Even though there is substance, the rival blocks the way, and for now it is hard to press forward and succeed.
2. Yuan Shen and Ji Shen

The third line's Wealth and the fourth line's Wealth both move, each turning into Offspring that generates them in return. The original text marks these as "Yuan Shen (the source element)," meaning the profit and resource side can give support. But although the first line's Offspring moves and turns into Siblings that generate it in return, the original text marks it as "Ji Shen (unfavorable element)." The fifth line's Offspring, on the responding position, moves and turns into Siblings that generate it in return, and is also marked as "Ji Shen." With the Ji Shen activated in two places, they instead seize the strength of the Yuan Shen. What the Yong Shen fears is precisely the Offspring, so in this cooperation one is easily held back repeatedly by conditions, distribution, and verbal promises.
3. Shi and Ying, movement and transformation

The self line is the Officer on the second line, and the responding line is the Offspring on the fifth line. Both the self and responding lines move: when the self line moves, one's intentions and role easily change; when the responding line moves and turns into Siblings that generate it in return, the other side's stance easily shifts. The original text's line "My rival is ill and cannot come near me" exactly matches the current standoff between self and responding. The auxiliary divination's top line says, "The flying sound rises to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune." When empty reputation is loudly proclaimed, misfortune follows. If the cooperation relies only on vision and momentum, it easily fails. The main divination's second line says, "A crane calls in the shade; its young respond. I have good wine; I will share it with you." This hints that one should first seek shared understanding and share the benefits, and only then will there be a turning point.
4. Ying Qi (expected timing)

The Yong Shen is in Xun Kong; only when it emerges from the void will substantive news appear. The void branches are Zi and Chou, so when Zi and Chou emerge from the void is the first observation window. Also, the Officer is at Hai, so the Hai month is one of the Ying Qi (expected timing). The conditions for success are: around the time of emerging from the void or the Hai month, there must be written, concrete implementation of authority, responsibility, and distribution, and both sides must no longer replace actual performance with the quarrels represented by the Siblings line. If one hears only words and sees no action, then the top line's "The flying sound rises to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune" will come true.

1. Generation and Overcoming of Self and Matter

The self trigram is Li (Fire), the matter trigram is Xun (Wood). Wood generates Fire, the matter generates the self; originally this is the matter helping the self. But this site's method takes the generating and overcoming of self and matter together with Yue Jian (month ruler) Xu. Xu is an Earth month; Fire generates Earth and drains its energy, and Wood is also consumed by Earth. Thus within generation there is drain; cooperation can succeed but the self easily becomes weary. The main divination text, the second line: A crane calls in the shade; its young respond. I have good wine; I will share it with you. This image shows mutual response and divisible benefit, hinting that the beginning of partnership has sincerity. The supporting divination text, the top line: The flying sound rises to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune. High calling without substance brings misfortune. So although the self and matter trigrams show generation, one must still guard against empty reputation.
2. The Nuclear Hexagram and the Resulting Hexagram

The Hu Gua (nuclear hexagram) is Guai · Breakthrough; the Bian Gua (resulting hexagram) is Zhong Fu · Inner Truth. Guai means breakthrough; Zhong Fu means trust. The Ding changing to Zhong Fu goes from vessel to trust; success or failure lies not in the size of the Ding but in whether there is trust. The primary hexagram, the fourth line: The Ding breaks its legs, overturning the duke's food; its appearance is soaked. Misfortune. If division of labor is unclear and support is unbalanced, it is like the Ding breaking its legs and spilling the food. The resulting hexagram, the third line: Meeting an opponent, some drum, some stop, some weep, some sing. In partnership, there is easily a sign of differing advance and retreat; it is best to set terms first.
3. Timing and Action

Yue Jian (month ruler) is Xu, Earth is strong. The self trigram Li (Fire) generates Xu Earth; the matter trigram Xun (Wood) overcomes Xu Earth. Wood and Earth fight, and matters are often repeated. The Ding hexagram statement: Great fortune. Success. This is originally smooth, but it does not mean success without effort. The Zhong Fu hexagram statement: Even pigs and fish are fortunate. It is favorable to cross the great river. It is favorable to be steadfast. Only when sincerity reaches even small creatures can one cross danger. This year's cooperation can be discussed and tested, but not trusted suddenly. Action should be small first and large later, clear first and joined later.
First establish written division of labor and exit clauses, then discuss investment.
Keep verifying high-profile promises; do not let show replace evidence.
Treat others with the trust of Zhong Fu, but keep the stability of the Ding's legs.
